remarks: Welcome to Ledgebrook! Nestled in the heart of Norwalk, this three bedroom, spacious ranch-style end unit awaits its new family! Features include a beautifully open living room/family room with wide double-sided fireplace, sliders to a covered patio and primary bedroom with ensuite bathroom. This unit is conveniently located towards the front of the complex yet boasts wonderful privacy and tranquil garden views. A commuters dream as Ledgebrook is just minutes to all major highways, shopping, public transportation and medical facilities. Two generous sized parking spaces are reserved in the covered parking garage just below the unit. With some minor cosmetics, this home is truly a gem and a rare find that wont last long! Welcome home!
